name: Converter
about: Any audio or video to the format you need: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG and more; trim, loudness, tempo, join. Recordings of any length
empty: Recordings and videos to the format you need. Audio is taken from video.
lossless: Lossless — same quality as the source
doneLib: Done — files are in the library
err.decode: Cannot read {type} without the FFmpeg pack
err.ffmpeg: Only the FFmpeg pack writes this format
p.trimHint: Time as “1:30” or seconds. Empty — from start to end. When joining — trims the joined file.
p.fadeHint: Smooth start and end — no click at the cut
libEmpty: The library has no recordings yet
noFF: This format needs the FFmpeg pack — available in the Android and desktop apps
err.ffmpeg-run: FFmpeg could not process the file
packHint: FFmpeg pack — all formats, recordings of any length (31 MB)
err.decodeFF: The file is damaged or has no audio
p.volHint: LUFS is perceived loudness, as streaming services use. A limiter keeps peaks below −1 dB.
p.speedHint: For practice: slower to work out a part, or into a comfortable key.
p.rateHint: “As is” keeps the source rate if the format accepts it.
p.peakSub: As loud as possible without distortion
p.monoSub: One channel instead of two — half the size
p.leftSub: Left only — e.g. vocal on a separate input
